errors.text_span: die in einer absteigenden Reihenfolge nach der Gesamthöhe der Balken angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: The categories are not sorted by the total length of the two bars combined. For example, the total length for "Überalterung der Belegschaft" (approx. 21+18=39) is greater than for "Zu hohe Personalfluktuation" (approx. 22+13=35), but it is placed lower in the list. The actual sorting is in descending order of the values for "Mindestlohnbetriebe" (the light blue bars).

errors.text_span: und bei übrigen Betrieben bei etwa 5 %
errors.evidence: For the category "Zu hoher Personalstand", the value for "übrige Betriebe" (dark blue bar) is visibly less than 5%, as the bar ends well before the halfway mark to the 10% tick. It is approximately 4%.
